description: Open one Mosaya practice, ready to begin: the person picks a length, taps Begin, and the sit runs full screen with a bell at the start and the end, then a short celebration. Use after find_practice, or when they name a practice. Nothing is stored.

minutes.description: A length the person asked for, if any.

practice.description: The practice to open, by its id from find_practice.
